parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides support and defines the overall shape and compartments of the furniture.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cabinet doors, shelves, and internal storage compartments, ensuring stability and durability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame itself is stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the front of the cabinet, typically hinged or sliding to allow access to the storage space inside.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and external exposure.
parts.Movement_description: The door can rotate or swing open and closed around its hinges or slide along a track, depending on the design.
